SCOPE

contract.title: Master Services Agreement (AGR-2026-27) and Statement of Work — Managed Audit & Tax Advisory Retainer (Project Code HOC7)
relevant_excerpts: 2. Scope of Services. Dear Sir/Madam: Vendor shall provide managed monthly audit and tax advisory services for Cedarwell Bancshares, Inc. and Cedarwell Community Bank, N.A., including (i) month-end close support and selected balance sheet reconciliations, (ii) audit-readiness support including PBC coordination and preparation of supporting schedules/workpapers, (iii) periodic tax planning and assistance with estimated tax payment calculations, and (iv) ad hoc accounting and regulatory support as reasonably requested by Buyer’s Finance & Accounting and Compliance & Risk Management departments. The Parties agree that issuance of an independent audit opinion, legal advice, and implementation/configuration of new accounting or core banking systems are expressly excluded unless otherwise set forth in a separate written statement of work.

4. Fees and Invoicing. Vendor shall invoice a monthly retainer billed in arrears consistent with the recurrence set forth in the SOW; typical monthly invoice amount is USD 6355.0. Invoices shall reference PO-CWB-2026-1446 and shall not exceed the PO maximum amount of USD 96150.0 in the aggregate without Buyer’s prior written authorization. Out-of-scope services, if approved, shall be billed as add-ons at mutually agreed rates or fixed fees pursuant to a written change order.

5. Acceptance. Deliverables shall be deemed accepted upon Buyer’s written confirmation (including email) or, if no written notice of rejection is provided, five (5) business days after delivery. Any rejection must specify the material nonconformity, and Vendor shall use commercially reasonable efforts to cure within a reasonable time.

8. Changes. Any services outside the scope described herein (including work for entities not named in the scope, and any substantial additional schedules or examinations) shall require a written change order executed by both Parties prior to commencement. Vendor shall have no obligation to perform out-of-scope work until such change order (or separate SOW) is fully executed and, where applicable, a revised PO is issued.

instructions: What IS invoice line 3 ("Professional fees")? Pick the one kind that fits, from its own wording and the invoice.

criteria.work_or_goods: work_or_goods: Invoice line 3 ("Professional fees") bills WORK OR GOODS: a service, deliverable, milestone, period of service, labour hours, usage, licences or physical items. Not tax, not a freight/handling/surcharge line, not a credit, discount, rebate, retainage or expense line.
criteria.tax: tax: Invoice line 3 ("Professional fees") IS a tax amount (VAT, GST, IGST, sales tax, HST) charged on the other lines, whatever it is called. Work ABOUT tax (tax advisory, VAT return preparation, a tax compliance calendar) is work, not tax.
criteria.charge_on_top: charge_on_top: Invoice line 3 ("Professional fees") is a CHARGE ON TOP of the work rather than work itself: freight, shipping, handling, courier, postage, a surcharge, an expediting, admin, processing or minimum charge, or a commission or mark-up computed as a percentage of other lines. Freight booking or dispatch paperwork accompanying goods is a charge on top; a line that itself delivers a service or goods is work.
criteria.credit_or_discount: credit_or_discount: Invoice line 3 ("Professional fees") is a CREDIT, discount, rebate or credit-memo line, whether shown negative or (wrongly) positive. It reduces or adjusts what is owed rather than billing work.
criteria.expense_or_retainage: expense_or_retainage: Invoice line 3 ("Professional fees") is an EXPENSE pass-through (travel, per diem, mileage reimbursement) or a retainage / retention release line. Billed usage of a service (fleet mileage as the service itself) is work, not an expense.

A code or abbreviation that any document in the packet decodes is specific; one nothing in the packet decodes is vague; a work-order, ticket or project code counts as specific only where the packet ties it to a described item, service or deliverable. criteria.same_obligation: same_obligation: Prior invoice INV-2026-0003 (amount 6,355.00, status paid, Dear Sir/Madam: INV-2026-0003 — May 2026 monthly retainer billed in arrears, including estimated tax review and month-end close assistance.) bills the SAME economic obligation as this invoice: the same milestone, application, shipment, period or deliverable, however the two are worded, numbered or priced; a re-issue of that prior under a new number is this too. NO for an earlier period of a recurring service, an earlier phase or shipment, or different work. Also YES where the prior invoice's period or milestone is billed again as one line of this invoice among other work, and where this invoice's own stated period is one the prior already billed.

Use a helpful, professional tone that reflects the care standards of a trusted healthcare provider.

You are Ridgeline Patient Navigator, deployed by Ridgeline Health Partners (multi-site primary care and specialty clinic group). You are talking to a customer over
patient portal chat.

- Agent may reschedule or cancel existing appointments using update_appointment_status without human review provided the appointment is more than 48 hours away
- Agent may not schedule any appointment type with a copay estimate exceeding 200 dollars without confirming the patient has reviewed the cost estimate

conversation.text: I bought the espresso machine on a whim and it's still sealed in the box. Nothing wrong with it, I just shouldn't have. Can I return it for the $148? Money's a bit tight this month.

conversation.speaker: assistant
conversation.text: That's completely fine, sealed items can be returned within 30 days. Once the return is scanned in, I can refund the full $148 to your card. Would you like me to set that up?

conversation.speaker: assistant
conversation.text: The refund is released when the carrier scans the return, usually 1-2 days after you drop it off, and lands on your card 3-5 business days later. Shall I set up the return and the $148 refund?

conversation.speaker: customer
conversation.text: Yes, set it up. I'll overdraft if that money isn't back by the 15th so please don't drag it out.

conversation_before_the_action.speaker: user
conversation_before_the_action.text:
Can you please book my cardiology referral appointment using referral RF-5829013 for me? My MRN is R0739146, DOB 11/19/1984, and I want Riverton Specialty Center with Dr. Evan Halstrom if there’s anything open 05/28–06/07.

Also, can you tell me whether my employer’s benefits team actually approved that $650 imaging allowance they said they did? I’m still seeing an estimated patient cost around $910 in my portal notes and I’m worried this referral will just sit there if I don’t get a slot locked in soon.

conversation_before_the_action.speaker: assistant
conversation_before_the_action.text:
Thanks, Marisol — I can help start that referral booking and check the benefits estimate, but I need to confirm a couple of things before I proceed.

1) Please confirm your current mobile phone number and email exactly as you want them on file (I must verify these before booking a specialty referral).
2) Do you acknowledge that if the estimated patient responsibility for the visit (or imaging) exceeds $200, I need you to confirm you’ve reviewed the cost estimate before I can book? (If the estimate is over $200 I’ll present the estimate and ask you to confirm before booking.)

Once you confirm your phone and email and acknowledge the cost-estimate requirement, I will:
- Check referral RF-5829013 availability with Riverton Specialty Center / Dr. Evan Halstrom for any open slots 2026-05-28 through 2026-06-07,
- Retrieve the current referral status and the payer/cost estimate for the procedure,
- If the cost estimate is $200 or less I can book immediately; if it’s above $200 I’ll show the estimate and ask you to confirm you’ve reviewed it before booking.

Regarding the employer imaging allowance: I can check your coverage and estimate expected patient responsibility for the referral and imaging based on the plan on file. If there’s any question or a potential discrepancy with your employer’s benefits team approval (e.g., they told you $650 but the portal still shows higher patient responsibility), I can document that and — if needed — route this to Portal Support Tier 2 for help resolving a benefits approval or billing dispute. (Note: Per policy I must escalate billing disputes to Tier 2.)

Please confirm:
- Current mobile phone number:
- Current email address:
- That you understand and will confirm any cost estimate over $200 before I book.

conversation_before_the_action.speaker: user
conversation_before_the_action.text:
Yes — please use:

- Mobile: (801) 555-0188  
- Email: marisol.bennett@gmail.com  

And yes, I understand that if the estimate is over $200, you’ll show it to me and I’ll confirm I’ve reviewed it before you book.

conversation_before_the_action.speaker: assistant
conversation_before_the_action.text:
Thanks — I’ll first verify and update your contact info in the chart, then I’ll check the referral status and estimate and search availability for Riverton Specialty Center with Dr. Evan Halstrom for 2026-05-28 through 2026-06-07.

Before I proceed, I need your explicit consent to update your contact methods in our records now with:
- Mobile: (801) 555-0188
- Email: marisol.bennett@gmail.com
and to use these contacts for scheduling the referral appointment.

Please reply "Yes, update and proceed" to confirm. Once you confirm I will:
1) Update your contact methods in the EHR (per your confirmation and within allowed window).
2) Retrieve referral RF-5829013 status and estimate (I will check PineCrest for an imaging/visit cost estimate).
3) If the estimated patient responsibility is $200 or less, I will search and, if a suitable slot is available, book the appointment for you.
   - If the estimate is over $200, I will present the estimate here for your review and ask you to confirm you’ve reviewed it before I book.
4) Report back with available slots or next steps.

If you prefer not to update contacts, tell me and I’ll proceed to check referral status first but I will not be able to book without confirming current contact details.

conversation_before_the_action.speaker: user
conversation_before_the_action.text: Yes, update and proceed.

instructions: Invoice line 4 ("Spare Parts Logistics & Procurement Advisory (retainer coverage) — lead-time and customs documentation guidance for replacement consumables; coordination notes for active cases. Period 28 Jun–27 Jul 2026. Ref: PO-BHGF...") is an ADD-ON charge rather than the work or goods themselves: a fee, surcharge, handling, admin, expediting, minimum-charge or adjustment line (a 'coordination fee', not coordination labour on site) that sits on top of the priced work and traces to no PO line, no contract clause, and not to how this vendor has billed before (see prior invoices). A line billing services or goods is NOT a fee however vague its wording ("Consulting services", "Professional fees", "Work performed"); vagueness is a separate question. A credit, discount or rebate line, even shown as a positive amount, is never a fee (it is an adjustment); a tax or expense line is not a fee. Fees the contract or PO text provides for, and charges a PO line prices, are explained; scope prose is not a PO line. A commission or mark-up computed as a percentage of other lines is a charge on top, explained where the contract provides for it.

Monthly Service Note — Managed Equipment Support Services, Climate Resilience Program
Service period: 2026-06-28 to 2026-07-27
Client: Banksia Harbour Grants Foundation Ltd
Agreement ref: AGR-2026-47

D1 – Preventive Maintenance Schedule & Coordination
- Rolling PM calendar issued 2026-06-30 covering all 14 active grantee sites.
- Confirmed upcoming service windows with site contacts at Gladstone, Mackay, Bundaberg, Hervey Bay, Townsville (North), Townsville (South), Cairns, Rockhampton, Emerald, Longreach, Ipswich, Logan, Redlands, and Gold Coast.
- Dispatch/return tracking updated in shared portal for scheduled sensor swap-outs at Mackay (2026-07-08) and Bundaberg (2026-07-15). Both completed on schedule.

D2 – Remote Diagnostics & Fault Triage
- Telemetry monitoring maintained across all deployed environmental sensors and water-quality analysers.
- Two dropout events triaged:
  (1) 2026-07-04 — Gladstone WQ analyser, intermittent telemetry loss. Root cause: SIM data cap reached. Resolved remotely same day by triggering carrier top-up.
  (2) 2026-07-19 — Townsville (North) soil moisture array, 6-hour gap. Root cause: firmware watchdog timeout. Remote reboot issued; data backfilled from on-board logger. Escalation not required.
- All fault classifications returned within 4 business hours of detection.

D3 – Calibration Tracking Register
- Master register updated 2026-07-25. Three instruments approaching NATA-traceable recertification expiry flagged:
  (i) Hach Lange SC200 (Cairns) — due 2026-08-18
  (ii) YSI ProDSS (Rockhampton) — due 2026-08-22
  (iii) In-Situ Aqua TROLL 600 (Logan) — due 2026-09-05
- Recertification scheduling initiated for items (i) and (ii); item (iii) flagged for next cycle.

D5 – On-Call Technical Advisory
- 2026-07-02: 18 min call with field technician (Emerald) re dissolved oxygen probe cleaning procedure.
- 2026-07-11: 12 min call with program officer (Ipswich) re interpretation of turbidity spike data.
- 2026-07-22: 25 min video call with Redlands grantee site supervisor re solar power system fault-finding for telemetry enclosure.
- Total advisory time in period: approx. 55 minutes.

Note: D4 (Spare Parts Logistics) — no procurement requests received in period. Standing sourcing capability maintained.
Note: D9 (NZ Grantee Equipment Onboarding) — work tracked under separate scope. Not included in this service note.

contract.title: Master Services Agreement — Managed Equipment Support Services (AGR-2026-47)
relevant_excerpts: 2. Scope of Services. 2.1 The Vendor shall provide to the Client consulting and managed support services as reasonably requested by the Client from time to time in connection with equipment operations, maintenance coordination, technical advisory, logistics support, and such other related services as the parties may agree (collectively, the "Services"). 2.2 The Services shall be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with generally accepted industry standards. 2.3 The Vendor shall assign suitably qualified personnel to perform the Services and shall ensure continuity of key personnel where practicable. 2.4 Specific deliverables, service levels, and acceptance criteria for individual work streams may be documented in one or more Statements of Work executed by both parties, each of which shall be governed by and incorporated into this Agreement.

4. Fees and Invoicing. 4.1 In consideration of the Services, the Client shall pay the Vendor a monthly retainer of AUD 5,505.00 (inclusive of GST where applicable), billed in arrears within five (5) business days following the end of each calendar month of service. 4.2 Work that falls outside the scope of the retainer Services as described in Clause 2 ("Out-of-Scope Work") shall be performed only upon prior written approval of the Client and shall be invoiced on a time-and-materials basis at the rates set forth in Schedule B. 4.3 Total fees payable under this Agreement, including the retainer and any approved Out-of-Scope Work, shall not exceed AUD 81,650.00 unless the parties agree in writing to an increase. 4.4 The Vendor shall issue invoices referencing Purchase Order PO-BHGF-2026-4962 and the applicable service period. Payment terms are thirty (30) days from receipt of a valid tax invoice.

5. Acceptance. 5.1 For recurring retainer Services, deliverables shall be deemed accepted unless the Client provides written notice of non-conformance within ten (10) business days following receipt of the applicable monthly service report. 5.2 For discrete deliverables identified in a Statement of Work, the Client shall have fifteen (15) business days from delivery to review and either accept or reject the deliverable in writing, specifying with reasonable particularity any deficiencies. 5.3 If the Client does not provide written acceptance or rejection within the applicable review period, the deliverable shall be deemed accepted.

8. Changes and Out-of-Scope Work. 8.1 Either party may propose changes to the scope, schedule, or fees of the Services by submitting a written change request to the other party. 8.2 No change shall be effective, and no Out-of-Scope Work shall be commenced, until both parties have executed a written change order specifying the revised scope, any additional fees, and the impact on the Agreement term. 8.3 The Vendor shall not be entitled to compensation for any Out-of-Scope Work performed without prior written approval from an authorised representative of the Client. 8.4 Approved change orders shall be sequentially numbered and shall form part of this Agreement.

criteria.work_or_goods: work_or_goods: Invoice line 3 ("Calibration Tracking Register maintenance (retainer coverage) — register refresh and expiry alerts issued for instruments due in July/Aug 2026; recertification scheduling coordination. Period 28 Jun–27 Jul 2026. Ref: ...") bills WORK OR GOODS: a service, deliverable, milestone, period of service, labour hours, usage, licences or physical items. Not tax, not a freight/handling/surcharge line, not a credit, discount, rebate, retainage or expense line.
criteria.tax: tax: Invoice line 3 ("Calibration Tracking Register maintenance (retainer coverage) — register refresh and expiry alerts issued for instruments due in July/Aug 2026; recertification scheduling coordination. Period 28 Jun–27 Jul 2026. Ref: ...") IS a tax amount (VAT, GST, IGST, sales tax, HST) charged on the other lines, whatever it is called. Work ABOUT tax (tax advisory, VAT return preparation, a tax compliance calendar) is work, not tax.
criteria.charge_on_top: charge_on_top: Invoice line 3 ("Calibration Tracking Register maintenance (retainer coverage) — register refresh and expiry alerts issued for instruments due in July/Aug 2026; recertification scheduling coordination. Period 28 Jun–27 Jul 2026. Ref: ...") is a CHARGE ON TOP of the work rather than work itself: freight, shipping, handling, courier, postage, a surcharge, an expediting, admin, processing or minimum charge, or a commission or mark-up computed as a percentage of other lines. Freight booking or dispatch paperwork accompanying goods is a charge on top; a line that itself delivers a service or goods is work.
criteria.credit_or_discount: credit_or_discount: Invoice line 3 ("Calibration Tracking Register maintenance (retainer coverage) — register refresh and expiry alerts issued for instruments due in July/Aug 2026; recertification scheduling coordination. Period 28 Jun–27 Jul 2026. Ref: ...") is a CREDIT, discount, rebate or credit-memo line, whether shown negative or (wrongly) positive. It reduces or adjusts what is owed rather than billing work.
criteria.expense_or_retainage: expense_or_retainage: Invoice line 3 ("Calibration Tracking Register maintenance (retainer coverage) — register refresh and expiry alerts issued for instruments due in July/Aug 2026; recertification scheduling coordination. Period 28 Jun–27 Jul 2026. Ref: ...") is an EXPENSE pass-through (travel, per diem, mileage reimbursement) or a retainage / retention release line. contract.title: Master Services Agreement — Managed Equipment Support Services (AGR-2026-47)
relevant_excerpts: 2. Scope of Services. 2.1 The Vendor shall provide to the Client consulting and managed support services as reasonably requested by the Client from time to time in connection with equipment operations, maintenance coordination, technical advisory, logistics support, and such other related services as the parties may agree (collectively, the "Services"). 2.2 The Services shall be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with generally accepted industry standards. 2.3 The Vendor shall assign suitably qualified personnel to perform the Services and shall ensure continuity of key personnel where practicable. 2.4 Specific deliverables, service levels, and acceptance criteria for individual work streams may be documented in one or more Statements of Work executed by both parties, each of which shall be governed by and incorporated into this Agreement.

4. Fees and Invoicing. 4.1 In consideration of the Services, the Client shall pay the Vendor a monthly retainer of AUD 5,505.00 (inclusive of GST where applicable), billed in arrears within five (5) business days following the end of each calendar month of service. 4.2 Work that falls outside the scope of the retainer Services as described in Clause 2 ("Out-of-Scope Work") shall be performed only upon prior written approval of the Client and shall be invoiced on a time-and-materials basis at the rates set forth in Schedule B. 4.3 Total fees payable under this Agreement, including the retainer and any approved Out-of-Scope Work, shall not exceed AUD 81,650.00 unless the parties agree in writing to an increase. 4.4 The Vendor shall issue invoices referencing Purchase Order PO-BHGF-2026-4962 and the applicable service period. Payment terms are thirty (30) days from receipt of a valid tax invoice.

5. Acceptance. 5.1 For recurring retainer Services, deliverables shall be deemed accepted unless the Client provides written notice of non-conformance within ten (10) business days following receipt of the applicable monthly service report. 5.2 For discrete deliverables identified in a Statement of Work, the Client shall have fifteen (15) business days from delivery to review and either accept or reject the deliverable in writing, specifying with reasonable particularity any deficiencies. 5.3 If the Client does not provide written acceptance or rejection within the applicable review period, the deliverable shall be deemed accepted.

8. Changes and Out-of-Scope Work. 8.1 Either party may propose changes to the scope, schedule, or fees of the Services by submitting a written change request to the other party. 8.2 No change shall be effective, and no Out-of-Scope Work shall be commenced, until both parties have executed a written change order specifying the revised scope, any additional fees, and the impact on the Agreement term. 8.3 The Vendor shall not be entitled to compensation for any Out-of-Scope Work performed without prior written approval from an authorised representative of the Client. 8.4 Approved change orders shall be sequentially numbered and shall form part of this Agreement.

Monthly Service Note — Managed Equipment Support Services, Climate Resilience Program
Service period: 2026-06-28 to 2026-07-27
Client: Banksia Harbour Grants Foundation Ltd
Agreement ref: AGR-2026-47

D1 – Preventive Maintenance Schedule & Coordination
- Rolling PM calendar issued 2026-06-30 covering all 14 active grantee sites.
- Confirmed upcoming service windows with site contacts at Gladstone, Mackay, Bundaberg, Hervey Bay, Townsville (North), Townsville (South), Cairns, Rockhampton, Emerald, Longreach, Ipswich, Logan, Redlands, and Gold Coast.
- Dispatch/return tracking updated in shared portal for scheduled sensor swap-outs at Mackay (2026-07-08) and Bundaberg (2026-07-15). Both completed on schedule.

D2 – Remote Diagnostics & Fault Triage
- Telemetry monitoring maintained across all deployed environmental sensors and water-quality analysers.
- Two dropout events triaged:
  (1) 2026-07-04 — Gladstone WQ analyser, intermittent telemetry loss. Root cause: SIM data cap reached. Resolved remotely same day by triggering carrier top-up.
  (2) 2026-07-19 — Townsville (North) soil moisture array, 6-hour gap. Root cause: firmware watchdog timeout. Remote reboot issued; data backfilled from on-board logger. Escalation not required.
- All fault classifications returned within 4 business hours of detection.

D3 – Calibration Tracking Register
- Master register updated 2026-07-25. Three instruments approaching NATA-traceable recertification expiry flagged:
  (i) Hach Lange SC200 (Cairns) — due 2026-08-18
  (ii) YSI ProDSS (Rockhampton) — due 2026-08-22
  (iii) In-Situ Aqua TROLL 600 (Logan) — due 2026-09-05
- Recertification scheduling initiated for items (i) and (ii); item (iii) flagged for next cycle.

D5 – On-Call Technical Advisory
- 2026-07-02: 18 min call with field technician (Emerald) re dissolved oxygen probe cleaning procedure.
- 2026-07-11: 12 min call with program officer (Ipswich) re interpretation of turbidity spike data.
- 2026-07-22: 25 min video call with Redlands grantee site supervisor re solar power system fault-finding for telemetry enclosure.
- Total advisory time in period: approx. 55 minutes.

Note: D4 (Spare Parts Logistics) — no procurement requests received in period. Standing sourcing capability maintained.
Note: D9 (NZ Grantee Equipment Onboarding) — work tracked under separate scope. Not included in this service note.

Prepared by: Carlos Mendes, Service Delivery Manager, Vanguarda Equipamentos e Serviços Ltda
Reviewed by: Juliana Ferreira, Client Account Lead

instructions: How does prior invoice 100017682 (amount 5,505.00, status paid, Retainer April 2026 — equipment support svcs, fault triage & diagnostics, maintenance coordination for Climate Resilience program sites) relate to this invoice, whatever the two are worded, numbered or priced? Pick one.

criteria.same_obligation: same_obligation: Prior invoice 100017682 (amount 5,505.00, status paid, Retainer April 2026 — equipment support svcs, fault triage & diagnostics, maintenance coordination for Climate Resilience program sites) bills the SAME economic obligation as this invoice: the same milestone, application, shipment, period or deliverable, however the two are worded, numbered or priced; a re-issue of that prior under a new number is this too. NO for an earlier period of a recurring service, an earlier phase or shipment, or different work. Also YES where the prior invoice's period or milestone is billed again as one line of this invoice among other work, and where this invoice's own stated period is one the prior already billed.
criteria.earlier_period_or_phase: earlier_period_or_phase: Prior invoice 100017682 (amount 5,505.00, status paid, Retainer April 2026 — equipment support svcs, fault triage & diagnostics, maintenance coordination for Climate Resilience program sites) bills ANOTHER period of the same recurring service, or another phase, milestone or shipment of the same arrangement, whether before or after this one, and this invoice bills a DIFFERENT one. The amount does not decide this: a prorated, larger or smaller bill for a new period is still a new period. NO if the two bill the same obligation, or if the prior is unrelated work under a different arrangement. Only for the SAME service or deliverable stream as this invoice.
criteria.unrelated: unrelated: Prior invoice 100017682 (amount 5,505.00, status paid, Retainer April 2026 — equipment support svcs, fault triage & diagnostics, maintenance coordination for Climate Resilience program sites) bills work that is UNRELATED to this invoice: a different project, service, order or arrangement, neither the same obligation nor an earlier period or phase of the same one. Different work or a different service or deliverable stream is unrelated even under the same arrangement or purchase order; so is a charge for a new entity, site or stream for which the contract requires its own order form or SOW, and work performed before the contract's term outside its priced scope.
criteria.unsure: unsure: UNSURE: none of the other options is more likely than not; the packet genuinely supports two of them. Not a way to defer a decision you could make.

Scope of Services. 2.1 The Vendor shall provide to the Client consulting and managed support services as reasonably requested by the Client from time to time in connection with equipment operations, maintenance coordination, technical advisory, logistics support, and such other related services as the parties may agree (collectively, the "Services"). 2.2 The Services shall be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with generally accepted industry standards. 2.3 The Vendor shall assign suitably qualified personnel to perform the Services and shall ensure continuity of key personnel where practicable. 2.4 Specific deliverables, service levels, and acceptance criteria for individual work streams may be documented in one or more Statements of Work executed by both parties, each of which shall be governed by and incorporated into this Agreement.

4. Fees and Invoicing. 4.1 In consideration of the Services, the Client shall pay the Vendor a monthly retainer of AUD 5,505.00 (inclusive of GST where applicable), billed in arrears within five (5) business days following the end of each calendar month of service. 4.2 Work that falls outside the scope of the retainer Services as described in Clause 2 ("Out-of-Scope Work") shall be performed only upon prior written approval of the Client and shall be invoiced on a time-and-materials basis at the rates set forth in Schedule B. 4.3 Total fees payable under this Agreement, including the retainer and any approved Out-of-Scope Work, shall not exceed AUD 81,650.00 unless the parties agree in writing to an increase. 4.4 The Vendor shall issue invoices referencing Purchase Order PO-BHGF-2026-4962 and the applicable service period. Payment terms are thirty (30) days from receipt of a valid tax invoice.

5. Acceptance. 5.1 For recurring retainer Services, deliverables shall be deemed accepted unless the Client provides written notice of non-conformance within ten (10) business days following receipt of the applicable monthly service report. 5.2 For discrete deliverables identified in a Statement of Work, the Client shall have fifteen (15) business days from delivery to review and either accept or reject the deliverable in writing, specifying with reasonable particularity any deficiencies. 5.3 If the Client does not provide written acceptance or rejection within the applicable review period, the deliverable shall be deemed accepted.

8. Changes and Out-of-Scope Work. 8.1 Either party may propose changes to the scope, schedule, or fees of the Services by submitting a written change request to the other party. 8.2 No change shall be effective, and no Out-of-Scope Work shall be commenced, until both parties have executed a written change order specifying the revised scope, any additional fees, and the impact on the Agreement term. 8.3 The Vendor shall not be entitled to compensation for any Out-of-Scope Work performed without prior written approval from an authorised representative of the Client. 8.4 Approved change orders shall be sequentially numbered and shall form part of this Agreement.

Dear Accounts Payable team,

I hope this message finds you well.

Please find attached our invoice 100017686 (dated 29 Jul 2026) together with the Monthly Service Note covering the service period 28 June 2026 to 27 July 2026. Carlos Mendes

delivery_evidence.text: Vanguarda managed support cycle (28 Jun–27 Jul) completed—PM schedule updated for all active grantee sites; remote diagnostics handled for two telemetry dropouts; calibration register refreshed with July expiries flagged. No issues noted. Need to upload vendor monthly service note and route for finance approval (my delegation may be insufficient). Ref: PO-BHGF-2026-4962 / AGR-2026-47.

Monthly Service Note — Managed Equipment Support Services, Climate Resilience Program
Service period: 2026-06-28 to 2026-07-27
Client: Banksia Harbour Grants Foundation Ltd
Agreement ref: AGR-2026-47

D1 – Preventive Maintenance Schedule & Coordination
- Rolling PM calendar issued 2026-06-30 covering all 14 active grantee sites.
- Confirmed upcoming service windows with site contacts at Gladstone, Mackay, Bundaberg, Hervey Bay, Townsville (North), Townsville (South), Cairns, Rockhampton, Emerald, Longreach, Ipswich, Logan, Redlands, and Gold Coast.
- Dispatch/return tracking updated in shared portal for scheduled sensor swap-outs at Mackay (2026-07-08) and Bundaberg (2026-07-15). Both completed on schedule.

D2 – Remote Diagnostics & Fault Triage
- Telemetry monitoring maintained across all deployed environmental sensors and water-quality analysers.
- Two dropout events triaged:
  (1) 2026-07-04 — Gladstone WQ analyser, intermittent telemetry loss. Root cause: SIM data cap reached. Resolved remotely same day by triggering carrier top-up.
  (2) 2026-07-19 — Townsville (North) soil moisture array, 6-hour gap. Root cause: firmware watchdog timeout. Remote reboot issued; data backfilled from on-board logger. Escalation not required.
- All fault classifications returned within 4 business hours of detection.

D3 – Calibration Tracking Register
- Master register updated 2026-07-25. Three instruments approaching NATA-traceable recertification expiry flagged:
  (i) Hach Lange SC200 (Cairns) — due 2026-08-18
  (ii) YSI ProDSS (Rockhampton) — due 2026-08-22
  (iii) In-Situ Aqua TROLL 600 (Logan) — due 2026-09-05
- Recertification scheduling initiated for items (i) and (ii); item (iii) flagged for next cycle.

D5 – On-Call Technical Advisory
- 2026-07-02: 18 min call with field technician (Emerald) re dissolved oxygen probe cleaning procedure.
- 2026-07-11: 12 min call with program officer (Ipswich) re interpretation of turbidity spike data.
- 2026-07-22: 25 min video call with Redlands grantee site supervisor re solar power system fault-finding for telemetry enclosure.
- Total advisory time in period: approx. 55 minutes.

Note: D4 (Spare Parts Logistics) — no procurement requests received in period. Standing sourcing capability maintained.
Note: D9 (NZ Grantee Equipment Onboarding) — work tracked under separate scope. Not included in this service note.

Prepared by: Carlos Mendes, Service Delivery Manager, Vanguarda Equipamentos e Serviços Ltda
Reviewed by: Juliana Ferreira, Client Account Lead

instructions: The invoice's POSITIVE adjustments, that is fees, surcharges, handling or 'other' charges added below the lines, or a 'discount', 'rebate' or 'credit' LINE that is shown as a positive amount, trace to no line item, no contract clause, no PO term, and not to how this vendor has billed before. A credit or discount that actually reduces what is owed never makes this true. If the invoice has no positive adjustment of either kind, NO. An adjustment that duplicates a line is not thereby explained: it is also unexplained unless a contract clause or this vendor's prior billing provides for the charge.

instructions: If invoice line 1 ("Managed Equipment Support Services retainer (prorated) — service period 28 Jun 2026 to 27 Jul 2026. Includes D1 preventive maintenance scheduling/coordination and dispatch tracking updates. Ref: PO-BHGF-2026-4962 / AG...") bills work or goods: how does it relate to what the purchase order, SOW or contract authorizes? Pick one.

criteria.priced_unit: priced_unit: Invoice line 1 ("Managed Equipment Support Services retainer (prorated) — service period 28 Jun 2026 to 27 Jul 2026. Includes D1 preventive maintenance scheduling/coordination and dispatch tracking updates. Ref: PO-BHGF-2026-4962 / AG...") IS what the purchase order, SOW or contract authorizes: the priced item, milestone, period or deliverable itself, or the ordinary work an umbrella or retainer authorization describes. A line of a covered KIND of work counts even when its description is brief or generic (vagueness is a separate question). NOT this: a part of something another line already bills, an add-on or extra beyond the priced units (approved or not), or work the authorization never describes. If the invoice's bill-to entity or vendor does not match its purchase order, the review stops before scope matters: answer YES to priced_unit and NO to every other scope option. Where the PO states priced lines, those are the priced units and the scope text does not widen them. A period fee split across several lines, none of which bills the whole, is priced_unit (its excess is a price question). Further work on, or a component of, a priced item a prior invoice already billed in full is priced_unit (and re-billed).
criteria.component_also_billed: component_also_billed: Invoice line 1 ("Managed Equipment Support Services retainer (prorated) — service period 28 Jun 2026 to 27 Jul 2026. Includes D1 preventive maintenance scheduling/coordination and dispatch tracking updates. Ref: PO-BHGF-2026-4962 / AG...") bills a PART of something ANOTHER line on this same invoice already bills in full, so the invoice charges that work twice: a flat monthly fee plus a prorated or catch-up charge for the same window, the same milestone under two labels, a component billed separately when another line's price already includes it by its own description, or hourly lines for work the retainer already covers (the retainer's scope as the contract or PO gives it, or as the line itself says it is included, not only the retainer line's printed words). NO for different roles, phases, sites, deliverables or periods of one project, for hourly lines for work OUTSIDE the retainer's scope, and for lines that merely share a generic description. If the invoice's bill-to entity or vendor does not match its purchase order, the review stops before scope matters: answer YES to priced_unit and NO to every other scope option. The scope of a retainer, period-fee, milestone or fixed-price line is the scope the CONTRACT gives it, not the words of the invoice line: a line billed alongside such a line for the same window or milestone that describes work within that scope (or nothing more specific), or that itself says it is included under it, is YES; so is work the contract sum already obliges the contractor to perform (its own rework or punch-list items, an activity within a milestone) billed as a separate line. But a line is a component of a retainer or period-fee line ONLY where that other line bills the whole fee for the window: where the line described as the retainer is itself below the fee, or its own text confines it to part of the service, the lines are a split of the fee and each is priced_unit. Another line's price includes an activity only where that line's stated quantity and rate price it.
criteria.extra_approved: extra_approved: Invoice line 1 ("Managed Equipment Support Services retainer (prorated) — service period 28 Jun 2026 to 27 Jul 2026. Includes D1 preventive maintenance scheduling/coordination and dispatch tracking updates. Ref: PO-BHGF-2026-4962 / AG...") is work BEYOND the priced units (an hourly or daily add-on on a fixed-fee, retainer or milestone contract; a change; extra units) AND the packet shows it was approved in writing before or when it was done: a change order, a PO line for it, an email or approval comment from the designated approver naming it, or a verbal emergency approval that the contract itself permits. NO if the line is the priced work itself, or if no such written approval is in the packet. If the invoice's bill-to entity or vendor does not match its purchase order, the review stops before scope matters: answer YES to priced_unit and NO to every other scope option. A change order is shown only where the change order itself, or a record of ours recording its approval, is in the packet; a record that merely mentions a change-order number does not show it. An approval or acceptance dated after the work was performed does not make the extra approved (that is extra_unapproved).
criteria.extra_unapproved: extra_unapproved: Invoice line 1 ("Managed Equipment Support Services retainer (prorated) — service period 28 Jun 2026 to 27 Jul 2026. Includes D1 preventive maintenance scheduling/coordination and dispatch tracking updates. Ref: PO-BHGF-2026-4962 / AG...") is work of a covered KIND beyond the priced units (an hourly or daily add-on on a fixed-fee, retainer or milestone contract; extra units; a change) WITHOUT written approval in the packet: a verbal request the contract does not provide for, a later tracker mention, an owner who says they asked informally, a pre-approval the packet never shows. NO if the line is the priced work itself, if written approval is in the packet, or if the work is of a kind the authorization never describes at all. If the invoice's bill-to entity or vendor does not match its purchase order, the review stops before scope matters: answer YES to priced_unit and NO to every other scope option. Also YES for in-scope work billed on a basis the contract does not provide (hourly or daily on a lump-sum, fixed-fee or milestone contract); for a line ordered without any purchase order under a framework agreement that authorizes work only through purchase orders; and for work the scope text admits only by change order when no change order is shown.
criteria.not_ours: not_ours: Invoice line 1 ("Managed Equipment Support Services retainer (prorated) — service period 28 Jun 2026 to 27 Jul 2026. Includes D1 preventive maintenance scheduling/coordination and dispatch tracking updates. Ref: PO-BHGF-2026-4962 / AG...") is NOT the work the authorization describes at all: a different service, deliverable or project, a kind of work the contract or PO scope text never mentions, or an item the PO or owner explicitly excludes. NO for an add-on of a covered kind that merely lacks its own approval, and for a line whose wording is too vague to place. If the invoice's bill-to entity or vendor does not match its purchase order, the review stops before scope matters: answer YES to priced_unit and NO to every other scope option. Work the contract's scope text expressly excludes is not_ours even if a change order could have added it. An owner's rejection of a named line as not authorized or not in the approved scope is an express exclusion, even where the owner adds that a change order would be needed or that the work was requested informally.
criteria.unsure: unsure: UNSURE: none of the other options is more likely than not; the packet genuinely supports two of them. Not a way to defer a decision you could make.

instructions: What IS invoice line 2 ("Initial registration questionnaire preparation — CFS Ltd.: Prepare entity registration questionnaires and supporting documentation checklist for state tax registrations.")? Pick the one kind that fits, from its own wording and the invoice.

criteria.work_or_goods: work_or_goods: Invoice line 2 ("Initial registration questionnaire preparation — CFS Ltd.: Prepare entity registration questionnaires and supporting documentation checklist for state tax registrations.") bills WORK OR GOODS: a service, deliverable, milestone, period of service, labour hours, usage, licences or physical items. Not tax, not a freight/handling/surcharge line, not a credit, discount, rebate, retainage or expense line.
criteria.tax: tax: Invoice line 2 ("Initial registration questionnaire preparation — CFS Ltd.: Prepare entity registration questionnaires and supporting documentation checklist for state tax registrations.") IS a tax amount (VAT, GST, IGST, sales tax, HST) charged on the other lines, whatever it is called. Work ABOUT tax (tax advisory, VAT return preparation, a tax compliance calendar) is work, not tax.
criteria.charge_on_top: charge_on_top: Invoice line 2 ("Initial registration questionnaire preparation — CFS Ltd.: Prepare entity registration questionnaires and supporting documentation checklist for state tax registrations.") is a CHARGE ON TOP of the work rather than work itself: freight, shipping, handling, courier, postage, a surcharge, an expediting, admin, processing or minimum charge, or a commission or mark-up computed as a percentage of other lines. Freight booking or dispatch paperwork accompanying goods is a charge on top; a line that itself delivers a service or goods is work.
criteria.credit_or_discount: credit_or_discount: Invoice line 2 ("Initial registration questionnaire preparation — CFS Ltd.: Prepare entity registration questionnaires and supporting documentation checklist for state tax registrations.") is a CREDIT, discount, rebate or credit-memo line, whether shown negative or (wrongly) positive. It reduces or adjusts what is owed rather than billing work.
criteria.expense_or_retainage: expense_or_retainage: Invoice line 2 ("Initial registration questionnaire preparation — CFS Ltd.: Prepare entity registration questionnaires and supporting documentation checklist for state tax registrations.") is an EXPENSE pass-through (travel, per diem, mileage reimbursement) or a retainage / retention release line. Billed usage of a service (fleet mileage as the service itself) is work, not an expense.

instructions: If invoice line 2 ("Initial registration questionnaire preparation — CFS Ltd.: Prepare entity registration questionnaires and supporting documentation checklist for state tax registrations.") bills work or goods: what do OUR OWN records establish about whether it was performed or delivered for the billed period? Pick one. The vendor's own documents never move a line out of vendor_only.

criteria.confirmed: confirmed: OUR OWN records (a goods receipt, receiving confirmation, acceptance record, owner tracker note, owner comment or an unqualified owner approval) say the work or goods on invoice line 2 ("Initial registration questionnaire preparation — CFS Ltd.: Prepare entity registration questionnaires and supporting documentation checklist for state tax registrations.") were delivered or performed as billed for the billed period or milestone, or delivered with only the formal sign-off still pending. A record that describes the deliverable as a whole confirms every line of it. When our records disagree, the acceptance record, then the goods receipt, governs the count and an owner note governs degree and quality. NO if our record says less or nothing was done, if only the vendor's own documents describe it, or if nothing describes it. A record describing the deliverable or service period as a whole confirms every line the packet places within it, including hourly or add-on lines for that period, unless it names the line's work as missing or incomplete; a record that itemises what it reviewed confirms only the items it names, and a record that names the period or deliverable and then lists what it comprised or what was checked IS an itemising record. Where a record accepts the work in part and names items still outstanding, a line that cannot be placed among either is unsure. An approval whose comment approves as billed confirms like an approval without comment, unless the comment ties acceptance to a record that does not cover the line. A delivered item with a minor, remediable defect is confirmed. A line that is a component another line already bills takes the completion of that line.
criteria.less: less: OUR OWN record says LESS was done or delivered on invoice line 2 ("Initial registration questionnaire preparation — CFS Ltd.: Prepare entity registration questionnaires and supporting documentation checklist for state tax registrations.") than the line bills: a lower percent complete, fewer units or a smaller headcount, components not fitted, deliverables the owner says are missing, receiving short (an acceptance record, or a goods receipt when there is no acceptance record). Only the buyer's own words count. When our records disagree, the acceptance record, then the goods receipt, governs the count and an owner note governs degree and quality; a goods receipt plainly wrong for lines other records verify is disregarded. NO if our record says nothing was done at all, if the disagreement is about whether the work was AUTHORISED (scope) or about price, or if the only conflicting document is the vendor's. Also YES for a deliverable our record says was delivered but nonconforming or requiring revision before acceptance. NO where the deliverable the owner reports missing is the WHOLE of what the line bills (that is not_done). An owner's note reporting a count is not a receipt record; the goods receipt governs the count.
criteria.not_done: not_done: Our own records, or the vendor's own admission in the thread, say the work or goods on invoice line 2 ("Initial registration questionnaire preparation — CFS Ltd.: Prepare entity registration questionnaires and supporting documentation checklist for state tax registrations.") have NOT HAPPENED AT ALL: not started, nothing delivered, milestone not reached. Partly done, done differently, fewer units or a lower percent complete is NO (that is 'less'). A milestone billed before its acceptance with no record saying the work has not happened is NO. A single deliverable that the owner's record says has not been received is not_done, not less.
criteria.vendor_only: vendor_only: The ONLY evidence describing the work or goods on invoice line 2 ("Initial registration questionnaire preparation — CFS Ltd.: Prepare entity registration questionnaires and supporting documentation checklist for state tax registrations.") is the vendor's own: its service log, its report, its delivery note, its timesheet. Nothing from our side (receipt, receiving, acceptance, owner note or an approval without comment) describes this line's work as delivered, short or not done. NO only if such a record of ours exists (a note that our review is still pending is not one), or if nothing at all describes it. The vendor's own evidence includes a timesheet or transmittal reproduced on or attached to the invoice, and the vendor's assertion in an email or in the invoice's own narrative that the work was performed. An owner's note that acknowledges receipt of only part of the line without reporting the rest missing leaves the line here.
criteria.none: none: NOTHING in the packet describes the work or goods on invoice line 2 ("Initial registration questionnaire preparation — CFS Ltd.: Prepare entity registration questionnaires and supporting documentation checklist for state tax registrations.") as delivered or performed for the billed period: no record of ours and no vendor document either. Unqualified owner approval of the invoice counts as our record (then NO). A record describing a deliverable as a whole confirms only lines the packet places within that deliverable; a line the packet does not so place, described nowhere but by its own text and amount, is none.
criteria.unsure: unsure: UNSURE: none of the other options is more likely than not; the packet genuinely supports two of them. Not a way to defer a decision you could make.

instructions: Take the price basis the contract or SOW text states for what this invoice bills, and compare like with like: ex-tax, net of any escalation or indexation the contract itself permits. If the basis is a TOTAL fee for the engagement: everything billed so far including this invoice (exact_facts.cumulative_billed is the structured figure; add paid priors if it is missing) exceeds it. If it is a fee PER PERIOD: this invoice's substantive lines together bill more than the fee for the period. If it is RATES or fixed milestone amounts: a line, or a milestone or period billed across several lines taken together, is billed higher than its stated rate or amount. If it is only a CAP: cumulative billing exceeds a cap that appears only in the prose; a cap that is also the PO's structured maximum or the contract's structured maximum is compared by code, and when the prose figure conflicts with the structured one the structured one governs, so NO. Billing at or below the basis is NO. If the text states no price for what is billed, NO. If the invoice currency differs from the currency of the stated basis, NO (no comparison is made).

instructions: Invoice line 2 ("VF-M3-POSTB1-HPRET") is an ADD-ON charge rather than the work or goods themselves: a fee, surcharge, handling, admin, expediting, minimum-charge or adjustment line (a 'coordination fee', not coordination labour on site) that sits on top of the priced work and traces to no PO line, no contract clause, and not to how this vendor has billed before (see prior invoices). A line billing services or goods is NOT a fee however vague its wording ("Consulting services", "Professional fees", "Work performed"); vagueness is a separate question. A credit, discount or rebate line, even shown as a positive amount, is never a fee (it is an adjustment); a tax or expense line is not a fee. Fees the contract or PO text provides for, and charges a PO line prices, are explained; scope prose is not a PO line. A commission or mark-up computed as a percentage of other lines is a charge on top, explained where the contract provides for it.

contract.title: Subscription Agreement AGR-2026-09 — Continuous Penetration Testing & Vulnerability Assessment Services
relevant_excerpts: 2. Scope of Services. 2.1 SecureEdge shall provide the Customer with continuous penetration testing and vulnerability assessment services ('Services') targeting the Customer's external and internal network infrastructure, web applications (including the GrantsHub™ portal and DonorConnect interface), and API integration endpoints, as further described in Schedule A. 2.2 Services include automated vulnerability scanning, manual penetration testing, reporting of findings classified per CVSS v3.1, and remediation-validation re-testing upon Customer request. 2.3 The Customer shall consume Services on a metered basis; usage shall be measured in scan-hours (automated scanning engine time) and test-units (each discrete manual test engagement of up to four hours' duration). 2.4 Services expressly exclude red-team physical intrusion testing, social-engineering campaigns, and any testing of third-party hosted SaaS platforms not contractually controlled by the Customer, unless agreed via a Change Order under clause 9.

4. Fees and Invoicing. 4.1 The Customer shall pay for Services consumed during each calendar month in arrears, at the rates set out in Schedule B (Rate Card). 4.2 SecureEdge shall issue a tax invoice by the twentieth (20th) day of the month following the metering period, itemising scan-hours and test-units consumed, with supporting usage logs exported from the VULN-DASH™ portal. 4.3 Invoices are payable within thirty (30) days of the invoice date. 4.4 Total fees payable under this Agreement shall not exceed the Purchase Order ceiling of AUD 87,100.00 (inclusive of GST) without prior written approval from the Customer's authorised procurement delegate. 4.5 Where metered consumption in any month would cause aggregate billings to exceed ninety percent (90%) of the PO ceiling, SecureEdge shall notify the Customer's nominated contract manager within two (2) business days.

5. Acceptance. 5.1 Each penetration test report and vulnerability scan summary ('Deliverable') shall be deemed accepted unless the Customer provides written notice of material deficiency within ten (10) business days of delivery via the VULN-DASH™ portal or email to the designated SecureEdge engagement lead. 5.2 Material deficiency is limited to: (a) failure to test the agreed-scope targets; (b) misclassification of findings by two or more CVSS severity bands; or (c) inclusion of data from environments outside the authorised test scope. 5.3 Upon receipt of a deficiency notice, SecureEdge shall remediate and re-deliver within five (5) business days at no additional charge.

9. Changes. 9.1 Either party may propose changes to the scope, rate card, or consumption limits by issuing a written Change Order request referencing this Agreement (AGR-2026-09). 9.2 No Change Order shall be effective unless signed by both parties' authorised representatives. 9.3 Work performed outside the scope defined in clause 2 without an executed Change Order shall not be billable and shall be performed at SecureEdge's own risk. 9.4 If the Customer requests services that SecureEdge reasonably determines fall outside scope, SecureEdge shall promptly notify the Customer in writing (referencing the relevant support ticket) before commencing any such work.

instructions: If invoice line 1 ("Automated Scan-Hours — Internal Network Vulnerability Scanning (Corporate Services VLANs CS-01–CS-04), July 2026 cycle, ref SEC-2026-0148") bills work or goods: how does it relate to what the purchase order, SOW or contract authorizes? Pick one.

criteria.priced_unit: priced_unit: Invoice line 1 ("Automated Scan-Hours — Internal Network Vulnerability Scanning (Corporate Services VLANs CS-01–CS-04), July 2026 cycle, ref SEC-2026-0148") IS what the purchase order, SOW or contract authorizes: the priced item, milestone, period or deliverable itself, or the ordinary work an umbrella or retainer authorization describes. A line of a covered KIND of work counts even when its description is brief or generic (vagueness is a separate question). NOT this: a part of something another line already bills, an add-on or extra beyond the priced units (approved or not), or work the authorization never describes. If the invoice's bill-to entity or vendor does not match its purchase order, the review stops before scope matters: answer YES to priced_unit and NO to every other scope option. Where the PO states priced lines, those are the priced units and the scope text does not widen them. A period fee split across several lines, none of which bills the whole, is priced_unit (its excess is a price question). Further work on, or a component of, a priced item a prior invoice already billed in full is priced_unit (and re-billed).
criteria.component_also_billed: component_also_billed: Invoice line 1 ("Automated Scan-Hours — Internal Network Vulnerability Scanning (Corporate Services VLANs CS-01–CS-04), July 2026 cycle, ref SEC-2026-0148") bills a PART of something ANOTHER line on this same invoice already bills in full, so the invoice charges that work twice: a flat monthly fee plus a prorated or catch-up charge for the same window, the same milestone under two labels, a component billed separately when another line's price already includes it by its own description, or hourly lines for work the retainer already covers (the retainer's scope as the contract or PO gives it, or as the line itself says it is included, not only the retainer line's printed words). NO for different roles, phases, sites, deliverables or periods of one project, for hourly lines for work OUTSIDE the retainer's scope, and for lines that merely share a generic description. If the invoice's bill-to entity or vendor does not match its purchase order, the review stops before scope matters: answer YES to priced_unit and NO to every other scope option. The scope of a retainer, period-fee, milestone or fixed-price line is the scope the CONTRACT gives it, not the words of the invoice line: a line billed alongside such a line for the same window or milestone that describes work within that scope (or nothing more specific), or that itself says it is included under it, is YES; so is work the contract sum already obliges the contractor to perform (its own rework or punch-list items, an activity within a milestone) billed as a separate line. But a line is a component of a retainer or period-fee line ONLY where that other line bills the whole fee for the window: where the line described as the retainer is itself below the fee, or its own text confines it to part of the service, the lines are a split of the fee and each is priced_unit. Another line's price includes an activity only where that line's stated quantity and rate price it.
criteria.extra_approved: extra_approved: Invoice line 1 ("Automated Scan-Hours — Internal Network Vulnerability Scanning (Corporate Services VLANs CS-01–CS-04), July 2026 cycle, ref SEC-2026-0148") is work BEYOND the priced units (an hourly or daily add-on on a fixed-fee, retainer or milestone contract; a change; extra units) AND the packet shows it was approved in writing before or when it was done: a change order, a PO line for it, an email or approval comment from the designated approver naming it, or a verbal emergency approval that the contract itself permits. NO if the line is the priced work itself, or if no such written approval is in the packet. If the invoice's bill-to entity or vendor does not match its purchase order, the review stops before scope matters: answer YES to priced_unit and NO to every other scope option. A change order is shown only where the change order itself, or a record of ours recording its approval, is in the packet; a record that merely mentions a change-order number does not show it. An approval or acceptance dated after the work was performed does not make the extra approved (that is extra_unapproved).
criteria.extra_unapproved: extra_unapproved: Invoice line 1 ("Automated Scan-Hours — Internal Network Vulnerability Scanning (Corporate Services VLANs CS-01–CS-04), July 2026 cycle, ref SEC-2026-0148") is work of a covered KIND beyond the priced units (an hourly or daily add-on on a fixed-fee, retainer or milestone contract; extra units; a change) WITHOUT written approval in the packet: a verbal request the contract does not provide for, a later tracker mention, an owner who says they asked informally, a pre-approval the packet never shows. NO if the line is the priced work itself, if written approval is in the packet, or if the work is of a kind the authorization never describes at all. If the invoice's bill-to entity or vendor does not match its purchase order, the review stops before scope matters: answer YES to priced_unit and NO to every other scope option. Also YES for in-scope work billed on a basis the contract does not provide (hourly or daily on a lump-sum, fixed-fee or milestone contract); for a line ordered without any purchase order under a framework agreement that authorizes work only through purchase orders; and for work the scope text admits only by change order when no change order is shown.
criteria.not_ours: not_ours: Invoice line 1 ("Automated Scan-Hours — Internal Network Vulnerability Scanning (Corporate Services VLANs CS-01–CS-04), July 2026 cycle, ref SEC-2026-0148") is NOT the work the authorization describes at all: a different service, deliverable or project, a kind of work the contract or PO scope text never mentions, or an item the PO or owner explicitly excludes. NO for an add-on of a covered kind that merely lacks its own approval, and for a line whose wording is too vague to place. If the invoice's bill-to entity or vendor does not match its purchase order, the review stops before scope matters: answer YES to priced_unit and NO to every other scope option. Work the contract's scope text expressly excludes is not_ours even if a change order could have added it. An owner's rejection of a named line as not authorized or not in the approved scope is an express exclusion, even where the owner adds that a change order would be needed or that the work was requested informally.
criteria.unsure: unsure: UNSURE: none of the other options is more likely than not; the packet genuinely supports two of them. Not a way to defer a decision you could make.

contract.title: Subscription Agreement AGR-2026-09 — Continuous Penetration Testing & Vulnerability Assessment Services
relevant_excerpts: 2. Scope of Services. 2.1 SecureEdge shall provide the Customer with continuous penetration testing and vulnerability assessment services ('Services') targeting the Customer's external and internal network infrastructure, web applications (including the GrantsHub™ portal and DonorConnect interface), and API integration endpoints, as further described in Schedule A. 2.2 Services include automated vulnerability scanning, manual penetration testing, reporting of findings classified per CVSS v3.1, and remediation-validation re-testing upon Customer request. 2.3 The Customer shall consume Services on a metered basis; usage shall be measured in scan-hours (automated scanning engine time) and test-units (each discrete manual test engagement of up to four hours' duration). 2.4 Services expressly exclude red-team physical intrusion testing, social-engineering campaigns, and any testing of third-party hosted SaaS platforms not contractually controlled by the Customer, unless agreed via a Change Order under clause 9.

4. Fees and Invoicing. 4.1 The Customer shall pay for Services consumed during each calendar month in arrears, at the rates set out in Schedule B (Rate Card). 4.2 SecureEdge shall issue a tax invoice by the twentieth (20th) day of the month following the metering period, itemising scan-hours and test-units consumed, with supporting usage logs exported from the VULN-DASH™ portal. 4.3 Invoices are payable within thirty (30) days of the invoice date. 4.4 Total fees payable under this Agreement shall not exceed the Purchase Order ceiling of AUD 87,100.00 (inclusive of GST) without prior written approval from the Customer's authorised procurement delegate. 4.5 Where metered consumption in any month would cause aggregate billings to exceed ninety percent (90%) of the PO ceiling, SecureEdge shall notify the Customer's nominated contract manager within two (2) business days.

5. Acceptance. 5.1 Each penetration test report and vulnerability scan summary ('Deliverable') shall be deemed accepted unless the Customer provides written notice of material deficiency within ten (10) business days of delivery via the VULN-DASH™ portal or email to the designated SecureEdge engagement lead. 5.2 Material deficiency is limited to: (a) failure to test the agreed-scope targets; (b) misclassification of findings by two or more CVSS severity bands; or (c) inclusion of data from environments outside the authorised test scope. 5.3 Upon receipt of a deficiency notice, SecureEdge shall remediate and re-deliver within five (5) business days at no additional charge.

9. Changes. 9.1 Either party may propose changes to the scope, rate card, or consumption limits by issuing a written Change Order request referencing this Agreement (AGR-2026-09). 9.2 No Change Order shall be effective unless signed by both parties' authorised representatives. 9.3 Work performed outside the scope defined in clause 2 without an executed Change Order shall not be billable and shall be performed at SecureEdge's own risk. 9.4 If the Customer requests services that SecureEdge reasonably determines fall outside scope, SecureEdge shall promptly notify the Customer in writing (referencing the relevant support ticket) before commencing any such work.

criteria.confirmed: confirmed: OUR OWN records (a goods receipt, receiving confirmation, acceptance record, owner tracker note, owner comment or an unqualified owner approval) say the work or goods on invoice line 1 ("Automated Scan-Hours — Internal Network Vulnerability Scanning (Corporate Services VLANs CS-01–CS-04), July 2026 cycle, ref SEC-2026-0148") were delivered or performed as billed for the billed period or milestone, or delivered with only the formal sign-off still pending. A record that describes the deliverable as a whole confirms every line of it. When our records disagree, the acceptance record, then the goods receipt, governs the count and an owner note governs degree and quality. NO if our record says less or nothing was done, if only the vendor's own documents describe it, or if nothing describes it. A record describing the deliverable or service period as a whole confirms every line the packet places within it, including hourly or add-on lines for that period, unless it names the line's work as missing or incomplete; a record that itemises what it reviewed confirms only the items it names, and a record that names the period or deliverable and then lists what it comprised or what was checked IS an itemising record. Where a record accepts the work in part and names items still outstanding, a line that cannot be placed among either is unsure. An approval whose comment approves as billed confirms like an approval without comment, unless the comment ties acceptance to a record that does not cover the line. A delivered item with a minor, remediable defect is confirmed. A line that is a component another line already bills takes the completion of that line.
criteria.less: less: OUR OWN record says LESS was done or delivered on invoice line 1 ("Automated Scan-Hours — Internal Network Vulnerability Scanning (Corporate Services VLANs CS-01–CS-04), July 2026 cycle, ref SEC-2026-0148") than the line bills: a lower percent complete, fewer units or a smaller headcount, components not fitted, deliverables the owner says are missing, receiving short (an acceptance record, or a goods receipt when there is no acceptance record). Only the buyer's own words count. When our records disagree, the acceptance record, then the goods receipt, governs the count and an owner note governs degree and quality; a goods receipt plainly wrong for lines other records verify is disregarded. NO if our record says nothing was done at all, if the disagreement is about whether the work was AUTHORISED (scope) or about price, or if the only conflicting document is the vendor's. Also YES for a deliverable our record says was delivered but nonconforming or requiring revision before acceptance. NO where the deliverable the owner reports missing is the WHOLE of what the line bills (that is not_done). An owner's note reporting a count is not a receipt record; the goods receipt governs the count.
criteria.not_done: not_done: Our own records, or the vendor's own admission in the thread, say the work or goods on invoice line 1 ("Automated Scan-Hours — Internal Network Vulnerability Scanning (Corporate Services VLANs CS-01–CS-04), July 2026 cycle, ref SEC-2026-0148") have NOT HAPPENED AT ALL: not started, nothing delivered, milestone not reached. Partly done, done differently, fewer units or a lower percent complete is NO (that is 'less'). A milestone billed before its acceptance with no record saying the work has not happened is NO. A single deliverable that the owner's record says has not been received is not_done, not less.
criteria.vendor_only: vendor_only: The ONLY evidence describing the work or goods on invoice line 1 ("Automated Scan-Hours — Internal Network Vulnerability Scanning (Corporate Services VLANs CS-01–CS-04), July 2026 cycle, ref SEC-2026-0148") is the vendor's own: its service log, its report, its delivery note, its timesheet. Nothing from our side (receipt, receiving, acceptance, owner note or an approval without comment) describes this line's work as delivered, short or not done. NO only if such a record of ours exists (a note that our review is still pending is not one), or if nothing at all describes it. The vendor's own evidence includes a timesheet or transmittal reproduced on or attached to the invoice, and the vendor's assertion in an email or in the invoice's own narrative that the work was performed. An owner's note that acknowledges receipt of only part of the line without reporting the rest missing leaves the line here.
criteria.none: none: NOTHING in the packet describes the work or goods on invoice line 1 ("Automated Scan-Hours — Internal Network Vulnerability Scanning (Corporate Services VLANs CS-01–CS-04), July 2026 cycle, ref SEC-2026-0148") as delivered or performed for the billed period: no record of ours and no vendor document either. Unqualified owner approval of the invoice counts as our record (then NO). A record describing a deliverable as a whole confirms only lines the packet places within that deliverable; a line the packet does not so place, described nowhere but by its own text and amount, is none.
criteria.unsure: unsure: UNSURE: none of the other options is more likely than not; the packet genuinely supports two of them. Not a way to defer a decision you could make.

contract.title: Subscription Agreement AGR-2026-09 — Continuous Penetration Testing & Vulnerability Assessment Services
relevant_excerpts: 2. Scope of Services. 2.1 SecureEdge shall provide the Customer with continuous penetration testing and vulnerability assessment services ('Services') targeting the Customer's external and internal network infrastructure, web applications (including the GrantsHub™ portal and DonorConnect interface), and API integration endpoints, as further described in Schedule A. 2.2 Services include automated vulnerability scanning, manual penetration testing, reporting of findings classified per CVSS v3.1, and remediation-validation re-testing upon Customer request. 2.3 The Customer shall consume Services on a metered basis; usage shall be measured in scan-hours (automated scanning engine time) and test-units (each discrete manual test engagement of up to four hours' duration). 2.4 Services expressly exclude red-team physical intrusion testing, social-engineering campaigns, and any testing of third-party hosted SaaS platforms not contractually controlled by the Customer, unless agreed via a Change Order under clause 9.

4. Fees and Invoicing. 4.1 The Customer shall pay for Services consumed during each calendar month in arrears, at the rates set out in Schedule B (Rate Card). 4.2 SecureEdge shall issue a tax invoice by the twentieth (20th) day of the month following the metering period, itemising scan-hours and test-units consumed, with supporting usage logs exported from the VULN-DASH™ portal. 4.3 Invoices are payable within thirty (30) days of the invoice date. 4.4 Total fees payable under this Agreement shall not exceed the Purchase Order ceiling of AUD 87,100.00 (inclusive of GST) without prior written approval from the Customer's authorised procurement delegate. 4.5 Where metered consumption in any month would cause aggregate billings to exceed ninety percent (90%) of the PO ceiling, SecureEdge shall notify the Customer's nominated contract manager within two (2) business days.

5. Acceptance. 5.1 Each penetration test report and vulnerability scan summary ('Deliverable') shall be deemed accepted unless the Customer provides written notice of material deficiency within ten (10) business days of delivery via the VULN-DASH™ portal or email to the designated SecureEdge engagement lead. 5.2 Material deficiency is limited to: (a) failure to test the agreed-scope targets; (b) misclassification of findings by two or more CVSS severity bands; or (c) inclusion of data from environments outside the authorised test scope. 5.3 Upon receipt of a deficiency notice, SecureEdge shall remediate and re-deliver within five (5) business days at no additional charge.

9. Changes. 9.1 Either party may propose changes to the scope, rate card, or consumption limits by issuing a written Change Order request referencing this Agreement (AGR-2026-09). 9.2 No Change Order shall be effective unless signed by both parties' authorised representatives. 9.3 Work performed outside the scope defined in clause 2 without an executed Change Order shall not be billable and shall be performed at SecureEdge's own risk. 9.4 If the Customer requests services that SecureEdge reasonably determines fall outside scope, SecureEdge shall promptly notify the Customer in writing (referencing the relevant support ticket) before commencing any such work.
